entries.headline: Novavax added to public COVID-19 programme from October 19; CDC urges early uptake
entries.zh: 115年度公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 提醒符合資格民眾儘早接種 還可獲得健康幣 另10月19日起新增提供不同製程之Novavax公費新冠疫苗
entries.why: This concerns the public programme (公費): Novavax is now a publicly funded COVID-19 option alongside Moderna, and the CDC says more flu and Novavax doses are planned. The notice does not address self-pay (自費) clinic stock or prices.
entries.headline_zh: Novavax自10月19日起納入公費COVID-19疫苗接種計畫；疾管署呼籲及早接種
entries.why_zh: 本則涉及公費計畫：Novavax現已與Moderna並列為公費COVID-19選項，疾管署表示計畫再增加流感疫苗與Novavax劑量。本則未提及自費門診庫存或價格。

entries.headline: CDC extends publicly funded flu antiviral eligibility to November 15
entries.zh: 疾病管制署延長擴大公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用對象「有類流感症狀，且具下列身分之流感高傳播族群」之適用期限至115年11月15日止，籲請醫師善用公費藥劑，共同防治流感(疾病管制署致醫界通函第617號)
entries.why: This is a public programme (公費) matter about treatment rather than vaccines, and it signals the flu season is still active. The CDC notes antivirals are not covered by National Health Insurance, a cost point for the public.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署將公費流感抗病毒藥物資格延長至11月15日
entries.why_zh: 本則屬公費計畫，主題為治療而非疫苗，顯示流感季仍在持續。疾管署指出抗病毒藥物未納入健保給付，這是民眾關注的成本問題。

entries.headline: CDC says rumoured US military ban on Moderna mRNA flu vaccine is false
entries.zh: 疾管署澄清網傳「十月十四日突發消息：五角大廈已在全美軍範圍內禁止採購和接種莫德納Moderna的mRNA流感疫苗」，為錯誤訊息並非事實，請民眾勿信勿轉傳
entries.why: The rumour touches the reputation of an mRNA flu product in Taiwan's public conversation, and the CDC attributes the US military's non-coverage to the US CDC not yet recommending it. The notice does not describe any change to Taiwan's programme.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署表示，傳言美軍禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗的說法不實
entries.why_zh: 此傳言影響台灣公眾討論中mRNA流感產品的聲譽；疾管署將美軍未採用歸因於美國CDC尚未建議該產品。本則未說明台灣計畫有任何變動。

entries.headline: Parents and a doctor debate self-paid infant RSV antibody cost
entries.why: This is a self-pay (自費) signal: one post says societies recommend a single dose for infants under 12 months at about NT$16,000 to 17,000, while NHI covers only high-risk premature infants. A parent also shares a hospital bill that included one RSV dose; these are social posts, not verified prices.
entries.headline_zh: 家長與醫師討論自費嬰兒RSV抗體費用
entries.why_zh: 這是自費訊號：一則貼文指出，學會建議12個月以下嬰兒接種單劑，費用約NT$16,000至17,000，而健保僅給付高風險早產兒。另有家長分享一張包含一劑RSV疫苗的醫院帳單；這些均為社群貼文，非經證實的價格。

entries.headline: Quadrivalent flu supply rumours and posts about low stock circulate
entries.why: For the self-pay (自費) market, clinic availability is the live question: two media explainers address claims that quadrivalent flu vaccine has disappeared. Coverage is from one outlet and no official supply statement appears in the coverage reviewed.
entries.headline_zh: 四價流感疫苗供應傳言及缺貨貼文流傳
entries.why_zh: 就自費市場而言，診所供應是當前焦點：兩則媒體解說回應四價流感疫苗已絕跡的說法。報導來自一家媒體，所審閱報導中未見官方供應說明。

entries.headline: Matsu's Nangan reports nearly 100 flu cases in half a month
entries.why: The article mentions self-paid vaccination during a local outbreak, a regional demand signal for the self-pay (自費) market. It does not report stock levels or prices.
entries.headline_zh: 馬祖南竿半個月內報告近100例流感病例
entries.why_zh: 本文提及地方疫情期間的自費接種，顯示區域自費市場的需求訊號。文中未報告庫存量或價格。

watch.text: Second stage of the 2026-27 public flu vaccination programme opens.
watch.text_zh: 2026-27年度公費流感疫苗接種計畫第二階段開始。

watch.text: Publicly funded flu antiviral eligibility extension ends, per the Taiwan CDC notice.
watch.text_zh: 依據疾管署公告，公費流感抗病毒藥物資格延長期限結束。

watch.text: Taiwan CDC says more flu and Novavax public doses are planned; the notice gives no timing.
watch.text_zh: 疾管署表示計畫再增加公費流感及Novavax劑量；公告未提供時程。

qa.q: Is the Novavax public COVID-19 option now settled within the programme?
qa.a: The Taiwan CDC says Novavax was added to the public COVID-19 programme from October 19, alongside Moderna, and that additional doses are planned. The notice gives no further quantities or dates.
qa.q_zh: Novavax公費COVID-19選項現在是否已正式納入計畫？
qa.a_zh: 疾管署表示，Novavax自10月19日起與Moderna並列納入公費COVID-19接種計畫，並計畫增加劑量。公告未提供更多數量或日期。

qa.q: Are official positions shifting on the Moderna mRNA flu rumour?
qa.a: No. The Taiwan CDC called the US military ban claim false and misleading on October 20, and said the US military has not covered the product only because the US CDC has not yet recommended it.
qa.q_zh: 官方立場對Moderna mRNA流感傳言是否有所改變？
qa.a_zh: 沒有。疾管署於10月20日表示美軍禁用的說法不實且具誤導性，並指出美軍未採用該產品，僅因美國CDC尚未建議。

qa.q: Is self-pay demand for infant RSV antibodies visible beyond social posts?
qa.a: Only in posts and one hospital-bill share. The coverage shows no official or media data on self-pay prices, stock or uptake, so the NT$16,000 to 17,000 figure should be treated as a poster's claim.
qa.q_zh: 嬰兒RSV抗體的自費需求，除社群貼文外是否可見？
qa.a_zh: 僅見於貼文及一則醫院帳單分享。報導未提供官方或媒體關於自費價格、庫存或施打率的數據，因此NT$16,000至17,000的數字應視為貼文者的主張。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: This notice set the 2026-27 narrative that public flu and COVID-19 uptake is outpacing last year and urged high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告定調2026-27年度敘事：公費流感與COVID-19疫苗接種進度超越去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種。

policy_notes.why: It sets out the Novavax addition from October 19 and strong public uptake messaging, the most consequential change for public tenders and eligibility in this set.
policy_notes.why_zh: 本則說明Novavax自10月19日納入計畫，並強調公眾接種的積極訊息，是本組內對公費採購與資格影響最大的變動。

policy_notes.why: It repeats the pre-holiday call to vaccinate with health coins, signalling continued public-campaign pressure into late October.
policy_notes.why_zh: 本則重申節前接種呼籲，並以健康券作為誘因，顯示公眾宣導壓力延續至10月下旬。

policy_notes.why: It repeats the antiviral extension and adds a public cost message that antivirals are not covered by National Health Insurance.
policy_notes.why_zh: 本則重申抗病毒藥物延長措施，並加入抗病毒藥物未納入健保給付的公眾成本訊息。

policy_notes.why: It extends the publicly funded flu antiviral window to November 15, keeping the flu season in the public programme's spotlight without changing vaccine eligibility.
policy_notes.why_zh: 本則將公費流感抗病毒藥物期限延長至11月15日，使流感季持續受公費計畫關注，但未改變疫苗資格。

policy_notes.why: It is an official rebuttal of a US military ban rumour on Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine, a reputational risk for mRNA flu products in Taiwan's conversation.
policy_notes.why_zh: 本則為官方對Moderna mRNA流感疫苗遭美軍禁用傳言的澄清，對台灣討論中mRNA流感產品的聲譽構成風險。

misinfo.claim: US military banned procurement and administration of Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine
misinfo.note: Taiwan CDC has already labelled it false; monitor for recirculation and point to the official clarification rather than repeating rumour details.
misinfo.claim_zh: 美軍禁止採購及施打Moderna mRNA流感疫苗
misinfo.note_zh: 疾管署已標示此說法不實；請持續監測是否再度流傳，並指向官方澄清，而非重述傳言細節。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines caused blood clots and deaths and mRNA vaccines are unsafe
misinfo.note: Recurs across several low-engagement posts; monitor for clustering and avoid amplifying individual claims.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗導致血栓與死亡，mRNA疫苗不安全
misinfo.note_zh: 此說法在多則低互動貼文中反覆出現；請監測是否形成群聚，並避免放大個別說法。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccine lipid nanoparticles spread to brain, heart and reproductive organs, and Pfizer concealed research
misinfo.note: Presented as established fact by a KOL-type account with 9 engagements; monitor for reuse, and note no official rebuttal appears in the coverage reviewed.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗脂質奈米粒子擴散至腦部、心臟及生殖器官，且輝瑞隱匿研究
misinfo.note_zh: 由KOL型帳號以9則互動量當作既定事實呈現；請監測是否被再利用，並注意所審閱報導中未見官方反駁。

misinfo.note: A Sin Chew Daily fact-check already labels the claim false; no new response is needed beyond pointing to the existing fact-check.
misinfo.note_zh: 世界新聞網（Sin Chew Daily）事實查核已將此說法標示為不實；除指向既有事實查核外，無需額外回應。

misinfo.claim: Paxlovid is a substitute for COVID-19 vaccines and should never be used
misinfo.note: Medicine-related misinformation; any response must stay non-promotional and run through official channels, not product messaging.
misinfo.claim_zh: Paxlovid可取代COVID-19疫苗，且絕不應使用
misinfo.note_zh: 屬藥物相關錯誤資訊；任何回應須保持非宣傳性，並透過官方管道進行，而非產品訊息。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccine is blamed for a possible cancer diagnosis
misinfo.note: Shared as a mocking viral story with high engagement; monitor whether it moves into serious coverage.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗被歸咎於可能的癌症診斷
misinfo.note_zh: 以高互動的嘲諷式病毒故事流傳；請監測是否進入嚴肅報導。

misinfo.claim: Quadrivalent flu vaccine has disappeared from supply
misinfo.note: Explainers already address the claim; monitor clinic stock messages and watch for any official supply statement.
misinfo.claim_zh: 四價流感疫苗已自供應端消失
misinfo.note_zh: 解說已回應此說法；請監測診所庫存訊息，並留意是否有官方供應說明。

narratives.para_zh: 家長與醫師討論嬰兒RSV抗體的自費費用、健保對高風險早產兒的有限給付，以及一歲以上幼兒的資格。

products.name: Beyfortus (nirsevimab)
products.signal: Posts this week discuss the cost of infant RSV antibodies: one doctor's post says societies recommend one dose for infants under 12 months at about NT$16,000 to 17,000 while NHI covers only high-risk premature infants, and a parent shares a hospital bill over NT$25,000 that included one RSV dose. Other posts ask about eligibility after age one and parents plan boosters.
products.implication: The discussion is about the self-pay (自費) market and out-of-pocket cost rather than the public programme, which this week's coverage does not show changing for RSV. Cost and eligibility questions are the main stakeholder pressure point.
products.action: Prepare an issue brief on cost-of-access and eligibility facts for infant RSV antibodies, verified against NHI rules, for use with paediatric societies and hospital departments; monitor how often cost posts recur.
who: NHI and Taiwan CDC policy staff
products.signal_zh: 本週貼文討論嬰兒RSV抗體的費用：一則醫師貼文指出，學會建議12個月以下嬰兒接種單劑，費用約NT$16,000至17,000，而健保僅給付高風險早產兒；一位家長分享一張超過NT$25,000、包含一劑RSV疫苗的醫院帳單。其他貼文詢問一歲以上的資格，且家長計畫施打加強劑。
products.implication_zh: 討論焦點在自費市場與自付費用，而非公費計畫；本週報導未顯示RSV公費計畫有所變動。費用與資格問題是主要的利害關係人壓力點。
products.action_zh: 請依健保規定核實，製作嬰兒RSV抗體取得費用與資格事實的議題簡報，供兒科學會及醫院科別使用；並監測費用相關貼文的重現頻率。
who_zh: 醫院新生兒科及兒科部門
健保署及疾管署政策人員

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine (Efluelda)
products.signal: Today's coverage has little specific to high-dose flu this week. The only mention is a media piece in which a health professional says flu can raise cardiovascular risk in older adults and advises assessing vaccination, referring to adjuvanted and high-dose options. Enhanced flu volume fell from 28 to 14 posts week on week.
products.implication: The public programme bought enhanced vaccines for people aged 65+ in long-term care first, so near-term attention is about eligibility and allocation. Self-pay availability for high-dose products is not visible in today's items.
products.action: Engage Taiwan CDC and long-term care facility contacts on allocation and eligibility questions; prepare evidence on the eligibility framework for enhanced flu vaccines without making comparative claims.
products.sub_zh: 增強型流感疫苗，高劑量，核准適用65歲以上
products.signal_zh: 今日報導中本週與高劑量流感疫苗相關的內容極少。唯一提及來自一則媒體報導，其中一位醫事人員表示流感可能增加長者心血管風險，並建議評估接種，其中提及佐劑型與高劑量選項。增強型流感疫苗聲量由上週28則降至14則。
products.implication_zh: 公費計畫優先為長照機構中65歲以上民眾購買增強型疫苗，因此近期關注焦點在資格與分配。今日項目中看不出高劑量產品的自費供應情形。
products.action_zh: 就分配與資格問題與疾管署及長照機構聯絡人接洽；準備增強型流感疫苗資格架構的證據，但不做比較性主張。

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Today's coverage contains no Tdap-specific items in the last 72 hours. Tdap appears only in a storyline about medical societies urging vaccines for chronic lung disease, which has no items in the last seven days. Volume is 3 against 0 previously, which is too small to read as a trend.
products.implication: There is no clear public or self-pay signal for Tdap this week, so no immediate issue is visible.
products.action: No immediate action. Keep watch on whether medical society guidance on chronic lung disease mentions pertussis, and check for self-pay clinic reporting.
products.signal_zh: 今日報導在過去72小時內沒有Tdap相關項目。Tdap僅出現在醫學會呼籲為慢性肺病接種疫苗的報導脈絡中，而該脈絡在過去七天內沒有任何項目。聲量為3則，先前為0則，數量太少，不足以視為趨勢。
products.implication_zh: 本週沒有明顯的Tdap公費或自費訊號，目前看不到即時議題。
products.action_zh: 目前無需立即行動。請持續留意醫學會關於慢性肺病的指引是否提及百日咳，並查核自費診所的相關回報。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: Protein-based XFG-strain COVID-19 vaccine; distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi
products.signal: The Taiwan CDC said Novavax's protein-based vaccine was added to the public COVID-19 programme from October 19 under the joint campaign, with additional doses planned. Social posts about COVID-19 safety are general and not specific to any brand.
products.implication: Novavax is now a public programme option, so its uptake, allocation and local availability are the public-programme issues to track. General COVID-19 safety misinformation affects the category as a whole and may spill into questions about the product.
products.action: Engage Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus on availability and allocation questions; prepare a Novavax-specific fact sheet on programme eligibility and logistics; set up a rapid-response line for general safety questions.
who: local health bureaus and participating clinics
products.sub_zh: 以蛋白質為基礎的XFG株COVID-19疫苗；由賽諾菲在台灣經銷
products.signal_zh: 疾管署表示，Novavax以蛋白質為基礎的疫苗自10月19日起在聯合宣導下納入公費COVID-19計畫，並計畫增加劑量。社群貼文中關於COVID-19安全的內容屬一般性，並未針對任何品牌。
products.implication_zh: Novavax現已成為公費計畫選項，因此其接種率、分配與地方供應是需追蹤的公費計畫議題。一般性COVID-19安全錯誤資訊影響整個類別，並可能延伸至對該產品的疑問。
products.action_zh: 就供應與分配問題與疾管署及地方衛生局接洽；準備Novavax專屬的事實說明，涵蓋計畫資格與後勤；設置快速回應專線，處理一般安全問題。
who_zh: 地方衛生局及參與診所

issues.title: Second-stage public flu programme opens for remaining eligible groups
issues.note: The second stage of the 2026-27 public programme starts on this date, which may shift eligible-group questions and enhanced flu allocation discussions.
issues.title_zh: 第二階段公費流感計畫開放其餘符合資格的族群
issues.note_zh: 2026-27年度公費計畫第二階段於此日開始，可能改變合格族群的相關問題及增強型流感疫苗的分配討論。

issues.title: Infant RSV antibody cost debate escalates in parent and clinical forums
issues.note: Cost and eligibility posts are rising and concern the self-pay market; a clear, sourced explainer on coverage would help clinics and parents.
issues.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV抗體費用爭論在家長及臨床論壇中升溫
issues.note_zh: 費用與資格相關貼文持續增加，且涉及自費市場；清楚且有來源的保險範圍說明，將有助於診所與家長。

issues.title: Flu supply and quadrivalent availability claims reach clinics and the public
issues.note: Posts claim flu stock is low and media are addressing quadrivalent disappearance rumours; unverified, so monitor clinic stock reports.
issues.title_zh: 流感供應及四價疫苗供應說法已觸及診所與民眾
issues.note_zh: 貼文稱流感庫存偏低，媒體正回應四價疫苗絕跡的傳言；此說法未經證實，請監測診所庫存回報。

self_pay.title: Infant RSV antibody out-of-pocket cost is the main self-pay discussion
self_pay.note: A doctor's post cites societies recommending one dose for infants under 12 months at about NT$16,000 to 17,000 while NHI covers only high-risk premature infants, and a parent's bill over NT$25,000 included one RSV dose. These are posts and anecdotes rather than verified price data.
self_pay.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV抗體的自付費用是主要的自費討論議題
self_pay.note_zh: 一位醫師的貼文引述學會建議12個月以下嬰兒接種單劑，費用約NT$16,000至17,000，而健保僅給付高風險早產兒；一位家長超過NT$25,000的帳單包含一劑RSV疫苗。這些屬於貼文與個案分享，而非經證實的價格數據。

self_pay.title: Flu stock and quadrivalent availability questions in the self-pay channel
self_pay.note: Media explainers address claims that quadrivalent flu vaccines have disappeared, and posts claim flu stock is below half. The items do not confirm clinic-level stock or prices, and no enhanced (adjuvanted or high-dose) self-pay availability is reported.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費管道中的流感庫存及四價疫苗供應問題
self_pay.note_zh: 媒體解說回應四價流感疫苗已絕跡的說法，貼文稱流感庫存低於一半。內容未能證實診所層級的庫存或價格，亦未報導增強型（佐劑型或高劑量）流感疫苗的自費供應情形。

self_pay.title: Little signal on self-pay for enhanced flu, Tdap and other products
self_pay.note: Today's items say little about self-pay pricing or clinic promotion for enhanced flu vaccines or Tdap, and demand from people outside eligible groups is not clearly visible. The only self-pay mention is a local outbreak report that refers to self-paid vaccination without detail.
self_pay.title_zh: 增強型流感、Tdap及其他產品的自費訊號很少
self_pay.note_zh: 今日項目對增強型流感疫苗或Tdap的自費定價或診所促銷所述甚少，符合資格族群以外的需求也未明顯可見。唯一提及自費的是一則地方疫情報導，僅提到自費接種而未說明細節。
